displayName: PromptPen – Prompt Enhancer for Copilot Chat
description: Fix typos, contradictions and unclear wording in your chat prompt before you send it, with the model you choose.
config.model: Language model used to improve prompts, as `vendor/id`. Leave empty to use the model selected in the chat view; when chat is set to Auto, PromptPen asks once. Use **PromptPen: Select Model…** to choose.
config.mode: How much PromptPen changes your prompt.
config.mode.fix: Minimal edits: spelling, grammar, unclear wording; contradictions become questions. Adds nothing new.
config.mode.expand: Also makes the prompt actionable with workspace context: relevant files, expected outcome, acceptance criteria.
config.askQuestions: Ask clarifying questions when the model finds contradictions or ambiguities.
config.context.workspace: Send workspace context (workspace name, active file and selection, open files, problems, Git status, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/copilot-instructions.md) to the model.
config.context.chatHistory: Also send the last turns of the current chat session. Reads VS Code's local chat logs, whose format is internal and may change; nothing is sent when they cannot be read.
config.context.maxChars: Maximum size of the context sent with a prompt, in characters.
config.showSummary: Show a short summary of the changes in the status bar.
config.statusBar: Show the PromptPen model in the status bar.
